gen-gf-hi-melody-fs-neco: Neco is a text serif whose strokes swell gently from hairline to stem and never pinch shut, giving it a dignified, measured tone. Hi Melody's tile-tight handwriting loosens things up.
gen-gf-hi-melody-fs-plein: Loose, huddled handwriting up top. Plein follows with a clear channel leading into each round letter, so it feels reliable and tidy; it is happiest at a modest size, well below the heading.
gen-gf-hi-melody-fs-recia: Scribbled warmth meets a sharper hand. Recia, a classic serif with moderate contrast and generous openings at every weight, keeps a longer passage feeling crisp and authoritative while Hi Melody stays a thread of ink.
gen-gf-hi-melody-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans spreads wide gaps between its curve ends and stems, drawing every stroke at identical weight for a contemporary, approachable feel. And Hi Melody's pressed-together handwriting supplies the casual, hand-drawn warmth above it.
gen-gf-hi-melody-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink with generous openings in every curve, clean and dependable. Synonym is sans-serif and not meant for long paragraphs, so Hi Melody's casual handwriting does the talking above it.
gen-gf-hi-melody-outfit: Outfit reads clean and approachable, its curves finishing well before they close, like cable bent into shapes. Outfit does its best work in brief copy, so a modest size under Hi Melody's huddled handwriting suits it.
gen-gf-hi-melody-sora: Precise, geometric, and wide open. Sora keeps its c and s widely parted with no pressure swell at the corners, so if Hi Melody's handwriting shrinks or Sora grows large, the casual charm gets lost.
gen-gf-hi-melody-space-grotesk: Hollow-reed counters, hand-drawn charm. Space Grotesk forms each glyph from a ribbon of constant width, and Hi Melody's tile-tight handwriting adds an inviting, casual twist above it.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-amulya: Amulya keeps the gaps in its curves generous, a contemporary plain sans with modern manners. Amulya also takes a modest size well, leaving Iansui's friendly, flared handwriting to carry the personality.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-neco: Friendly is Iansui's mood, its diagonals as thick as its uprights and its curve ends gently flared apart. Neco, a classic serif with a measured hairline-to-stem swell, keeps a longer passage dignified and open.
